description: Collaborated with a cross-functional team to design and develop responsive frontend pages for a Vendor Onboarding Portal using ReactJS, improving user experience and usability. Implemented Firebase Authentication to secure the portal, reducing unauthorized access by 100% and saving 2-3 hours of daily manual verification boosting onboarding efficiency by 40%

Contributed to the development of the FitHub website, a centralized platform for fitness guidance, completing 100% of the project milestones on time. Developed and integrated the FitBuddy chatbot, an AI-driven virtual fitness companion, improving chatbot response time by 30%. Successfully deployed the website and chatbot within 5 Weeks.
Developed a structured portal to monitor staff check-ins and attendance records efficiently. Implemented a digital system to track spare parts, manage stock levels, and automate billing
